rows.author: C407
rows.title_full: AN ACT  PROVIDING FOR THE DEVELOPMENT AND PRESERVATION OF PHILIPPINE CULINARY HERITAGE
rows.abstract:
Proposes the establishment of the Committee on Philippine Gastronomy and Culinary Heritage with powers, functions, and duties that include the continuous conduct, formulation of implementation standards, and the annual funding of regional and national Buwan ng Kalutong Filipino/Filipino Food Month activities.
Tasks DepEd, DA, DOST, and DOT to conduct food heritage mapping; to promote and raise the awareness of the importance of culinary heritage and tradition preservation; to identify and record tangible culinary resources making use of geographic tools; to conduct regional culinary identity mapping, taking into consideration geography, the food culture of indigenous people; foods and cooking techniques; and economic viability and providing evidence of regional cuisine.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2021-12-01

rows.author: C407
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF LOCAL STUDIES CENTERS IN STATE UNIVERSITIES AND COLLEGES (SUCs) THROUGHOUT THE PHILIPPINES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Provides that the Centers shall serve as research institutions that focus on the grassroots level with the thrust of identifying, recognizing, documenting, conserving, preserving, and promoting local history, folklore, language, and other aspects of cultural heritage through academic, scientific, and scholastic approaches.
Proposes the patronage of publications produced by the Center by the following:  Historical Data Bank of the National Historical Commission of the Philippines, the National Library of the Philippines, and the University of the Philippines Diliman Filipiniana Library; the DFA shall purchase and disseminate to all Sentro Rizal cultural centers in foreign service posts; the local school board and the DepEd shall do the same for public and private schools, and the DILG and NLP for public libraries.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HIGHER AND TECHNICAL EDUCATION since 2021-12-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMMUNITY ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES OFFICE OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENT AND NATURAL RESOURCES TO ISSUE PERMITS FOR THE CUTTING, GATHERING, AND UTILIZATION OF NATURALLY GROWN TREES IN PRIVATELY-OWNED LANDS
rows.title_short: Authorizing The Community Environment And Natural Resources Office Of The Department Of Environment And Natural Resources To Issue Permits For The Cutting, Gathering, And Utilization Of Naturally Grown Trees In Privately- Owned Lands
rows.abstract:
Covers all applications for the cutting, gathering, and utilization of natural grown trees in private and titled lands.

Penalizes any public officer, found for abuse of authority, or grave misconduct in the issuance of permits or certifications in violation of this Act and its implementing rules and regulations.

Makes other acts such as commission of bribery, extortion or other illegal act in order to secure the issuance of permit or license subject of this Act a criminal liability and shall be sanctioned with fine or imprisonment, or both.

rows.author: I105
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING INCENTIVES AND OTHER BENEFITS TO ALL FORCE MULTIPLIERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to grant Volunteers and Force Multipliers that are accredited by the PNP and LGUs the following:  a monthly allowance of P2,500; an exemption from income taxation all amounts received and other emoluments, gross benefits of whatever kind or character shall likewise be exempt from taxation; and the sale, exchange or disposition of real property shall be exempt from capital gains and other transfer taxes.
Seeks to provide free primary health services and medicines and free legal services of the Public Attorney´s Office (PAO) if they shall be a party litigant in administrative and criminal cases filed in connection with the performance of their assigned duties.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2021-12-14

rows.author: I105
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING RETIREMENT BENEFIT TO FORCE MULTIPLIER
rows.abstract:
Proposes to establish a retirement benefit for Philippine National Police force-multipliers in the amount of P50,000.00 provided that he shall be at least 65 years of age and with at least ten (10) years in service.
Provides that in case such volunteer dies or becomes permanently incapacitated while in the performance of duty, he shall be entitled to the same amounts of benefits irrespective of age and number of years in service.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SAFETY since 2021-12-14
